groups.activity: clear the six objectives, defeat The Fragmented
groups.mode: check your rolled loadout before choosing difficulty

rows.label: Scuttler Husk
rows.note: 16-20 per run (20-24 SP), not a drop chance

conditions: Your own Warframe and Arsenal play the whole way; no Drifter, no Companions, no Gear wheel (the Gear key summons your Kaithe instead).
Resource Boosters do not apply to Scuttler Husks.
bonuses: Steel Path pays 50% more husks (20-24) and 5 Steel Essence, but only when the Duviri spiral rolled you gear you've actually built; check the loadout before launching, or run normal.
Isleweaver's end reward table can also hand you Temporal Dust and other build materials incidentally.

disclosures.title: reroll a bad loadout
disclosures.body: Running one stage of The Circuit and backing out rerolls the offered Duviri frames and weapons; the rotation persists a couple of hours.

conditions: The exchange only appears talking to Acrithis in the Dormizone; she doesn't offer it out in Duviri.

rows.label: Thalys
rows.note: 100 Temporal Dust, 1,500 Entrati Obols, 180 Silphsela, 150 Rune Marrow

disclosures.title: unlocking the Incarnon
disclosures.body: 100 kills unlocks Evolution I, which must be manually selected in the Arsenal even though it's the only option. Evolution III (20 Ground Finishers) is the one real speed bump; Vazarin's pull, Vauban, Mag's Pull or Garuda's 1 knock enemies down en masse so you can land the finisher.
